intent_verdict.page_type_caveat: Google prefers CATEGORY/COLLECTION and BRAND-HOMEPAGE URLs over single product-detail pages: only 1 of 18 organic URLs is a /product/ URL. Skyflex's target is a WooCommerce /product/ detail page, so it is fighting the dominant page type.
intent_verdict.shopping_signal: The sibling SERP for the head term 'bbq pods' (serp-organic-bbq-pods.json) carries a popular_products block plus images and short_videos — a shopping/transactional SERP.

recommended_primary.why: Only viable head term with real volume whose SERP is the same product-retailer SERP as the current primary: 12 organic domains overlap between serp-organic-bbq-pods-melbourne.json (16 organic domains) and serp-organic-bbq-pods.json (15 organic domains) — including futureshade, expressportables, konoba, elitepods, bbqpodsydney, pmkpods, outdoorlivinghq, madebytait, shedcity and tbkmetal. - **Entertainer & Social Pods:** Ranging between $19,250 and $23,950, featuring larger layouts, integrated TVs, and extended bench space.[](https://expressportables.com.au/collections/bbq-pods) [[1]](https://expressportables.com.au/collections/bbq-pods)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:1709509888967921798&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://outdoorlivinghq.com.au/product/diablo-outdoor-kitchen-pod/)[[4]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DVYXhIfEopg/)[[5]](https://www.outdoorsdomain.com.au/products/artusi-80cm-316-grade-stainless-steel-built-in-bbq-with-hood)

- **Installation:** Delivered fully assembled as a plug-and-play unit.
